decisions.quote: The theory underpinning this study suggests that superordinate ILTs contain a small number of attributes that appear across all basic and subordinate ILTs and that subordinate ILTs are a subset of basic level ones. Our findings align poorly with these ideas.
decisions.reason: Under Rule 1 of the codebook, an explicit overall verdict on the replication as a whole decides the outcome even where individual hypothesis tests (such as H1a or partial support for H1c) point elsewhere. Across the introduction, discussion opening, and conclusion, the authors consistently state an overall unfavorable verdict that their findings align poorly with and challenge the core hierarchical and subset assumptions of Lord et al. (1984), even framing the observed commonality across levels as challenging the assumption that superordinate ILTs contain only a small, limited set of shared attributes. Additionally, the shipped quote does not appear in the supplied full text.
